answer: Each identity receives a single juniper tag whose serial is locked to its key. The tag lets it cultivate one plot in a public garden; only signed, re-runnable work from that plot counts. A rotating grove of established peers audits the plots and burns any tag whose work is copied or idle. Tags are non-transferable and expire with the epoch, so a farm cannot share one serial across aliases and must fund a new tag and a new audit for every head.
